summary: Verified BookPanel close UX fix. All 5 scenarios passed: 3D book click opens side panel, Close button is visible at y=112 (below 72px navbar), Close button closes panel, backdrop click closes, Escape closes, regression re-open works. Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: BookPanel implementation is clean: uses AnimatePresence-friendly motion.div wrapper as backdrop with onClick=onClose, motion.aside stops propagation, Escape key handled via useEffect, close button has proper aria-label and data-testid. No issues.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Book click coordinates that worked at 1920x800 after scroll to window.innerHeight*2.6 + 3.2s wait: first hit at (1200,365). Sweep x=1150-1450 step 25, y=340-600 step 25 with 200ms wait reliably opens a panel. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' for goto (networkidle times out due to Lenis/Three RAF).
rca of the issue: Original bug (close button under navbar) fixed by adding pt-24 md:pt-28 top padding to the aside, backdrop wrapper with onClick=onClose, and Escape keydown listener. Verified visually: close button rendered at y=112, clearly below the 72px fixed navbar.
